name: Simisage
description: Simisage, the Thorn Monkey Pokémon, and the evolved form of Pansage. A Grass type.
pokedex_entries: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.
